touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Whittington qualifies as a local detour through WHITTINGTON CASTLE and CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Whittington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Whittington offers WHITTINGTON CASTLE, CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST, SUNDIAL APPROXIMATELY 3 METRES SOUTH OF NAVE OF CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: WHITTINGTON CASTLE
